title: Chesang takes commanding win in Osaka

story.W: A big group went through 5 km in 16:44 and halfway in 1:10:13, with Japanese runners Izawa and Matsuda dropping off early. Four women led at 25 km: Yada, Edesa, Chesang and Hirpa. The pacemakers left at 30 km and the pack split after about 38 km. Chesang took the lead by 40 km, held off a late pass by Yada, and pulled clear in the last two kilometres to win by 23 seconds.

performances.name: Stella CHESANG
performances.note: Won in 2:19:31 with a break in the final two kilometres. First Ugandan woman to win a Platinum Label marathon; national record-holder.

performances.name: Bedatu HIRPA
performances.note: Second in 2:19:54. Was in the leading four at 25 km and the leading three at 41 km.

performances.name: Workenesh EDESA
performances.note: The defending champion finished third in 2:19:56 after running in the front group throughout and being passed by Yada late on.

performances.name: Mikuni YADA
performances.note: Marathon debut: fourth in 2:19:57, the fastest debut by a Japanese woman. Helped lift the pace after 30 km and went past Hirpa and Edesa after 40 km.

performances.name: Mao UESUGI
performances.note: Fifth in 2:23:07. Briefly lost contact near halfway, regained the group, then was chasing at 25 km.

performances.name: Nanaka IZAWA
performances.note: Was in the early lead group but drifted off before 15 km and lost touch for good before 25 km.
